title: Founder Live Approval Request Boundary
objective: Define governed local approval request boundaries for future founder/operator approval requests without granting approval submission, approval capture, approval persistence, runtime admission, execution, mutation, deploy, network, or spend authority.
safetyRules: No approval writes that unlock execution.
No runtime admission or live mode transition.
No deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
No raw private project IDs in primary Command Center UX.
No full Command Center demo leakage.
reuseRequired: existing dashboard cards, tabs, badges, route matrix, evidence, audit, and activity helpers

subphases.title: Approval Request Contract / Schema Baseline
subphases.narrowGoal: Define the P106 approval request boundary contract and local schema without enabling approval request submission, approval capture, approval persistence, or execution.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.envelope: Result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, sourceApprovalPhase, approvalRequestEnvelopeShape, approvalRequestDecisionShape, requiredEvidence, forbiddenActions, requiredEvidenceCount, approvalRequestSubmissionAllowed false, approvalRequestCaptureAllowed false, approvalRequestPersistenceAllowed false, approvalRequestCanUnlockExecution false, approvalRequestRuntimeAdmissionAllowed false, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, and commandCenterVisible false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.approvalRequestEnvelopeShape: Display-safe approval request envelope with requestKey, displayLabel, sourceApprovalPhase, currentState, requestSubmissionAllowed false, approvalCaptureAllowed false, approvalPersistenceAllowed false, executionUnlockAllowed false, runtimeAdmissionAllowed false, requiredEvidence, missingEvidence, forbiddenActions, validationCommands, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, and all blocked flags false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.approvalRequestDecisionShape: Display-safe approval decision boundary with decisionKey, displayLabel, currentState, decisionOptions, decisionCaptureAllowed false, decisionPersistenceAllowed false, decisionCanUnlockExecution false, runtimeTransitionAllowed false, validationCommands, disabledReason, and all blocked flags false.
